articleTitle: A Survey on Clustering Approaches for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Due to the rapid advancement of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology for a wide range of applications, it has become an active research topic among the scientist community. Wireless sensor network (WSN) being the major component of IoT, have also got attraction in recent years. However, WSN being an energy constrained network, designing energy-aware protocol is of vital importance. Clustering in WSN has shown significant energy efficiency by enhancing the network lifetime, conserving energy and bandwidth. But, a clustered WSNs suffers from a major problem called energy hole or hotspot problem. In this problem, nodes in the vicinity of remote station drain out of energy much earlier as compared to its distant counterparts. This makes the remote station unreachable from the network. In this paper, a comprehensive survey of different clustering protocols is presented and analysed by considering different clustering properties.

Author Keywords: Clustering, Wireless sensor networks, Hotspot, Energy efficient, Network lifetime

articleTitle: TOPSIS in Multi-Criteria Decision Making: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper presents a systematic review of an outranked multi-criteria decision making (MCDM) method and its application for solving many complex real life issues. The method Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) is discussed along with its strengths, weakness and area of application.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As of late, deep learning has gained remarkable growth in various fields, for example, computer vision and natural language processing. Contrasted with conventional machine learning strategies, deep learning has a robust learning capacity and can improve utilization of datasets for feature extraction. In view of its practicability, deep learning turns out to be increasingly mainstream for many researchers to do research works. In this paper we mainly focus on the optimization of different parameters of convolutional neural network of deep learning for classifying 8000 labelled natural images of cat and dog. First the convolutional neural network is trained to learn features then ANN binary classifier is used for classification. Various level of optimization have been done to improve the performance level of the network and finally, we achieved the best classification accuracy of 88.31%.

Author Keywords: deep learning, machine learning, neural network, convolutional neural network

articleTitle: IoT Based Secure Smart City Architecture Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Standard security protocols are heavy weight interms of memory foot prints which make all the security protocol unfit for budgeted platforms such as Internet of Things (IoT). The blockchain (BC) is a very efficient architecture to preserve five basic cryptographic primitives, such as authenticity, integrity, confidentiality, availability and non-repudiation. Conventional adoption of blockchain in IoT causes significant energy consumption, delay, and computational overhead which are not suitable for various resource-constrained IoT devices. In our submission we change the basic architecture of blockchain and make it more efficient for IoT application. The article proposes an IoT based smart city architecture which adopted the blockchain technology preserving all the cryptographic security issues. The adoption of blockchain causes very minimal overhead on IoT platform. Comparison of all security parameters with existing literature shows that the architecture is reasonably efficient in terms of security

articleTitle: Research on an Electronic Medical Record System Based on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The medical records are the records of the patient's disease occurrence, development, examination, diagnosis, and treatment. Medical records are an important part of medical care, teaching, prevention, research and development. They are the basic support conditions for hospital management. It is difficult to keep the traditional paper medical records. It is also difficult to query the paper medical records. With the development of information technology, it is possible to realize the medical record management through information systems. The electronic medical record system is very important for the digital management of the medical records. It has greatly improved the hospital's management efficiency. The electronic medical records data can be used for medical big data analysis.

Author Keywords: information technology, electronic medical record system, data storage, big data analysis

articleTitle: An Approach towards Text to Emoticon Conversion and Vice-Versa Using NLTK and WordNet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Sentiment analysis on instant messaging and social media, is a significant and well covered area of research in Natural Language Processing. Emoticons are most popularly used in text based communication. This paper presents a new and simple approach towards text to emoticon conversion and vice-versa using input text processing with WordNet<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>. Proposed work is an attempt to recognize emotion from sms (short messaging service) and social media text consisting with, or, without emoticon.

Author Keywords: Text to emoticon, Emoticon to text, Sentiment analysis, Text emoticons, Synonyms

articleTitle: Solar Powered Smart Irrigation System Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the present scenario, availability of power and water are insufficient to satisfy the farmer's requirements. Traditionally, implemented techniques of irrigation are proving to be less futile as these are not good at multitasking different concerns which is a combination of availability of water, sources of energy and timely soil profile analysis. With the merger of automation and the methods of irrigation used earlier, the scope to mitigate issues concerning water and power crisis, is huge. In this paper, an Internet of Things based solar powered smart irrigation system with monitoring and control features, is designed and implemented. The sensor enabled proposed model of smart irrigation system along with its Android Application and ESP8266 as its main controller is successfully implemented and the results of the implemented are presented.

Author Keywords: Internet of things, automated irrigation, ESP8266

articleTitle: NLP-QA Framework Based on LSTM-RNN
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The paper mainly majors in question answering system(QA). The original natural response theory originated from Alan Turing's Turing Machine Theory in 1950. Nowadays, the best way to implement a QA system is the Deep Learning. This project is based on the Seq2Seq model theory, I design and implement an automatic question answering system model based on LSTM-RNN algorithm. The paper completely describes the framework and design ideas of the entire system. it realizes the following aspects:1)A Seq2Seq model based on LSTM-RNN.2) We design the QA framework adapts to different chat scene. Results show that the average of perplexity is 2.92. And model's loss is 1.07. To some extent, it reduces the resistance of deep learning in developing. The design and implementation of the framework simplifies the development process and facilitates the user's own data set.

articleTitle: Analysis of Resampling Method for Arrhythmia Classification Using Random Forest Classifier with Selected Features
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: There are many developed techniques to be experienced for biomedical data mining. Due to the growing number of cardiac patients, many data are stored by different organizations. It helps to work with data mining for medical signals. Here In this work, an attempt for analysis and classification of arrhythmia cardiac disease is taken by authors. Data collected from the UCI repository to validate the purposed method. The features from the data are chosen using correlation-based feature selection (CFS) method due to the elimination of redundant data. For better processing and classification the selected data is to be resampled and is done in this work using random sampling. Random forest classifier is used for classification purpose. The performance is evaluated with resampled data and exhibited in result section. It is found that the average accuracy is 96% with random resampling technique.

Author Keywords: cardiac arrhythmia, correlating based feature selection, simple random sampling, random forest

articleTitle: Comparison of Neural Network Models for Speech Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This work compares the performance of three prominent Neural Network based classifiers for speech emotion recognition (SER). The classifiers such as the Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), the Radial Basis Function Network (RBFN) and the Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN) have been tested for their effectiveness in recognizing speech emotions such as angry, sad, bore and happy states from Berlin (EMO-DB) database. The self-learning ability of these classifiers to capture complex input and output relationship effectively makes them versatile in the field of SER. Hence, these parallel structured networks are expected to provide the intended accuracy for the proposed task as speech frequencies occur in parallel. Extensive simulation of these classifiers has been carried out using the popular Vector Quantized based Linear Predictive Cepstral Coefficients (LPCC_VQ) and the excitation source Hurst components. The PNN has shown to outperform all others in classifying the chosen emotional states using the extracted feature sets. The LPCC_VQ remains more discriminating for the proposed SER system than the pH as our results reveal. The average classification error using the LPCC-VQ feature sets has been 0.173 for the PNN as compared to 0.185 with RBFN and 0.227 with MLP as observed from our results.

Author Keywords: Emotion recognition, Feature extraction, Neural network, Classification, Hurst parameter

articleTitle: Effect of Class Imbalanceness in Detecting Automobile Insurance Fraud
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This article demonstrates a novel fraud identification methodology in auto insurance sector with the help of an adaptive oversampling technique (ADASYN). Initially, the data imbalanceness is removed from the original claim data set by employing ADASYN on the minority class instances. Three different classifiers, namely, Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree and Multi Layer Perceptron are further used for classifying the anomalous records from the normal ones. The efficacy of the models are tested with the 10-fold cross validation methodology. The performance of the model is demonstrated by several tests carried out on an auto insurance data set. Moreover, the outcomes justify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm on a balanced data set over an unbalanced one.

Author Keywords: Automobile Insurance Records, Fraud Detection, Class Imbalance, Adaptive Synthetic Oversampling, Supervised Classifier

articleTitle: CT Image Denoising Using Double Density Dual Tree Complex Wavelet with Modified Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Due to low radiation dose and software fault, CT images are noisy. How to extraction of meaningful information from noisy CT images are challenging works. In this work, we present a new denoising algorithm for CT image using double density dual tree complex wavelet transform (DDCWT). Firstly, we use DDCWT decompose noisy CT image into high frequency and low frequency components. In the next, a modified threshold is used for DDCWT coefficient. Finally, the denoised image is obtained by reconstructing high frequency and low frequency components through inverse decomposition of DDCWT. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved DDCWT can maintain more rich details and have a higher practical value.

Author Keywords: dual tree complex wavelet transform, image denoising, the threshold approach

articleTitle: Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy Images Using a Fully Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to develop a model for the classification of diabetic retinopathy, a prime cause for blindness that appears due to prolonged diabetes. A deep learning model based on fully convolutional neural network is developed to classify the disease from fundus image of the patient. Here, proposed neural network consists of only six convolutional layers along rectified linear unit (ReLu) activation and max pooling layer. The model trains faster as compared to traditional convolutional neural network models as the absence of fully connected layer reduces the computational complexity. The validation of the proposed model is carried out by training it with a publicly available High-Resolution Fundus (HRF) image database. The model is also compared with various existing state-of-the-art methods which shows competitive result as compared to these models. The intelligence of our model lies in its ability to re-tune weight to overcome outliers encountered in future. The proposed model works well with an accuracy of 91.66%.

Author Keywords: Diabetic Retinopathy, Fundus Images, Convolution Neural Network

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm for Semantic Similarity Based on HowNet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This thesis puts forward an improved algorithm for semantic similarity based on HowNet. This method is built on the sememe tree, and continues to use the thought of calculation of semantic similarity based on the semantic distance, and has made two improvements in this idea. Firstly, the influence of the children's node density under the common parent node on semantic similarity is increased, and the problem of parallel similarity between words with different information densities is corrected. Secondly, the similarity calculation between words of polysemy terms is reconsidered. The problem of the existence of different word concepts between polysemy terms, through a comprehensive calculation of semantic terms, has been corrected. The methods put forward in the thesis can also improve the situation of improper classification of HowNet words and the imperfection of its sememet. After experimental tests, it is a method with high efficiency and practicality.

Author Keywords: based on HowNet, semantic similarity of words, node density, polysemy terms, semantic distance

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Using Multilevel Thresholding and Genetic Algorithm: An Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The segmentation aims the partitioning of a digital image into segments/objects in order to simplify its analyze. Its comprehensive application makes it an important section of computer vision studies where thresholding is one of the most important techniques. This paper proposes the application of a genetic algorithm associated with a thresholding method in a way that it makes more practical the location of optimal thresholds in view of the fact that the expansion in multiple thresholds of already consecrated methods to perform this processing might be too memory consuming and time exhaustive to the system. A comparison between values reached by the proposed method and Otsu's method are presented for one and two levels showing good results, in addition to the application and results in higher levels of the proposed algorithm which are visual satisfactory to distinguish the original objects by human vision with low range variations of the value.

articleTitle: Moving Object Detection Using Background Subtraction in Wavelet Domain
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Detecting and tracking of any suspicious moving objects is of the prior importance in video surveillance. In this paper, the background subtraction method has been employed in the wavelet transform domain. By masking the approximate wavelet coefficient to zero, the detailed coefficients provide the necessary information about the moving objects only, thereby reduces the probability of misdetection and overcome the illumination variations. The performance of transform domain method has been compared with popular three-frame differencing method, both employing background subtraction, global thresholding and morphological dilation. The proposed method is relatively superior to that of the later case on visual inspection.

Author Keywords: Background subtraction, three frame differencing, wavelet transform, global thresholding, Dynamics extraction

articleTitle: Isolated Odia Digit Recognition Using HTK: An Implementation View
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper outlines the frame work for an isolated Odia digit recognition. The HTK toolkit which consider the Hidden Markov Model (HMM), as the base for developing the system. The recording environment is simple and created using the HTK tool. Initially the system is trained for 900 signals of 10 Odia digits spoken by 10 different speakers. The work done on this paper also signifies the role of HTK tool commands, applied in various levels of the system advancement. 10 samples, (each sample consists of 10 untrained signal) from the untrained 100 signals are considered for testing at each time. The trial results show that the average performance of our system is encouraging.

articleTitle: Tracking Comparison of P&O and INC Based MPPTs under Varying Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) based charge controllers are designed for the extraction of maximum power from the solar Photovoltaic (SPV) arrays. But in field condition, MPPT algorithms face enormous environmental challenges such as fluctuating irradiance, partial shading, and temperature rise while tracking maximum power point (MPP) of the PV system. During these situations, the Perturb-and-Observe (P&O) and Incremental Conductance (INC) type of MPPTs are considered as the best and efficient techniques in term of tracking speed, power, and efficiency. In this paper, both the P&O and INC MPPT techniques are tested and compared under different variable conditions using MATLAB/Simulink. It is found that the performance of both the MPPTs differs from each other in term of tracking speed, power, and efficiency.

Author Keywords: Solar Photovoltaic, maximum power point tracking, perturb-and-observe, incremental conductance, fluctuating irradiance, partial shading

articleTitle: Net Asset Value Prediction Using Extreme Learning Machine with Dolphin Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Net Asset Value prediction of different mutual funds is highly essential for different investors. But prediction of such financial time series data is very difficult task as NAV data are nonlinear in nature. Various researchers have used feed forward neural network models involving gradient descent learning in NAV prediction. But these models have certain limitations of local optima and slow convergence. In this work, Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) with Dolphin Swarm Algorithm (DSA-ELM) is taken as the prediction model. Dolphin Swarm Algorithm (DSA), a swarm based optimization algorithm based on the living habits of dolphins is considered for the optimization of ELM parameters. This DSA-ELM model is used for the NAV prediction of two of the Indian mutual funds and the performance is compared with the standard ELM. From the results, it is observed that the prediction performance of DSA-ELM is better as compared to standard ELM.

articleTitle: A Statistical Approach for Ocular Artifact Removal in Brain Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Brain signal analysis is a complex task. Many cases artifacts are generated at the time of signal acquisition. In this paper authors have taken an approach using statistical technique to remove the artifacts from the signal. For such attempt a new-multiscale sample entropy (new-MSE) along with the statistical method kurtosis are used for identification of artifact. Considering the automated threshold, the application of wavelet transform is performed to evaluate the exact co-efficient. Further the inverse of the transform helps to construct the artifact free signal. Proposed method proves its efficacy and is shown in the result section. Also, the signals are visually inspected in form of waveform.

Author Keywords: Electroencephalogram (EEG), Independent components (ICs), Kurtosis, New multiscale sample entropy (new-MSE)

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Parallel FIR Filter Using Modified Distributed Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: We proposed a area efficient architecture implementation of finite impulse response (FIR) Filter using Distributed Arithmetic. Area complexity in the fir filter is mainly increased for the multipliers. To overcome this drawback the multiplier less techniques distributed arithmetic is most preferred area efficient technique to implement FIR filter. In this technique, partial products of filter coefficients and input sample are precomputed and stored in lookup table (LUT) and multiplication is done by shift and accumulate operations on these partial products. However, the size of the LUT will increase exponentially with the increase of number of coefficient that means no of order of the filter. If the co-efficient is small, it is very convenient to implement. While the coefficient is large, it will take up a lot of storage resources of FPGA and reduce the calculation speed. This report presents the modification of the Distributed Arithmetic algorithm by partitioning the LUT size and parallelism in the FIR filter by processing multiple bit at a time. We presented 16-tap FIR filter in serial and parallel mode, with different size of memory partitioning of LUT and synthesis result shows improvement in performance in terms of speed as well as saving in area. The proposed architecture using vhdl model are synthesized with Xilinx ISE 14.4.

Author Keywords: Distributed Arithmetic, FIR Filter, Speedup, Hardware Implementation, FPGA

articleTitle: Forecasting of China Consumer Price Index Based on EEMD and SVR Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of using ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) method for Chinese consumer price index. We analysis the periodicity and volatility of the Intrinsic Mode Function (IMF), they reveal the fluctuation information of Chinese consumer price index at different scales and prove the rationality and effectiveness of the ensemble empirical mode decomposition method. We use a hybrid EEMD and Support Vector Regression (SVR) model to forecast Chinese consumer price index. The hybrid method has higher precision. It can support certain reference value to the economic development strategy.

articleTitle: Application of Fractional Calculus in Speech Enhancement: A Novel Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In day-to-day life, voice is most common part of communication. While the processing of speech signal in data science, mostly noise affects these signals. As a preprocessing technique in data mining, the signal is to be normalized and noise free that can process fast. In this work, the concept of fractional calculus is applied for enhancement. For this Grunwald-Letnikove (G-L), Caputo and Riemann-Liouville (R-L) methods are used for enhancement by decomposing the signal. The comparison results show that R-L outperforms better than other methods in terms of signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) perceptual evaluation of speech quality (PESQ) and log spectral distance (LSD).

articleTitle: Design of a Quadcopter UAV for Flood Area Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Unmanned Air Vehicles (UAV) are extensively used in military and civil applications. This paper proposes the design of Quad rotor, based on PID control with Type 2 Fuzzy Logic application. It can be used for collection data in the flood prone areas. A camera is connected with the Quad copter. The feedback obtained from the model will be updated in the main database when the model is subjected to any natural calamity. The PID Control helps in automating the vehicle by controlling the uncertainties of its 4 distinct motions; throttle, roll, pitch and yaw respectively. The Type 2 fuzzy logic provides certain rules along with type reduction for actuating the different controls. The Interval Type 2 fuzzy logic is used because of its intelligence and potential to deal effectively with high nonlinear systems, imprecise data and reduces the noise level effectively than Type 1 Fuzzy Logic. The use of this type of Controller makes the system modular and increases its adaptability and robustness. Further, the work can be focused upon the detailed study of the real world communication of the quad rotor with the environment.

Author Keywords: UAV, Quad rotor, PID Control, Interval Type 2, Fuzzy Logic, throttle, roll, pitch, yaw, actuating

articleTitle: QoS Based Performance Analysis of AODV and DSR Routing Protocols in MANET
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs) are wireless networks with self-organised mobile nodes that are connected wirelessly without any base station. In MANETs, a mobile node can act as an end system as well as a router during packet transmission. For packet transmission, MANETs use varieties of routing protocols which are classified as pro-active, re-active and hybrid routing protocols. In this paper, two on-demand unicating routing protocols are considered namely Ad hoc Demand Distance vector (AODV) and Dynamic Source Routing (DSR) in order to evaluate their performance based on Quality of Service (QoS). For MANETs. Both AODV and DSR routing protocols are implemented on the basis of on-demand gateway discovery algorithm where each node can communicate with each other through the entry and exit point of a network as and when required. Through simulation with increasing the node density using ns-2 network simulator, we perceive that the performance of AODV and DSR routing protocols are varying according to situation as directed to premier the performance level for both of these protocols. The results gives out in this paper decorate the significance in carefully assessing and executing both of these protocols for MANETs.

articleTitle: Determining the Best Clustering Number of K-Means Based on Bootstrap Sampling
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In this paper, the selection of clustering number in K-means clustering algorithm is studied, based on the Bootstrap sampling, a new method is proposed to determine the best clustering number based on the between the actual value of total within-cluster sum of squares and its estimated interval. By UCI Machine Learning Repository and randomly generated artificial simulated test data sets, the experimental results show that using clustering has obvious improvement, the method can overcome falls into local optimum caused by unreasonable clustering number to select. K-means algorithm.

articleTitle: Recognition and Classification of Multiple Power Quality Disturbances with S-Transform and Fast S-Transform Using ELM Based Classifier
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The paper aims to develop an effective method to identify, detect and classify power quality disturbances using the efficient Extreme learning machine (ELM). It's important to evaluate the learning time while designing any kind of computational algorithms, which used for classification. ELM comprises of a single hidden layer Feed Forward Neural Network (SFNN) with better generalization ability and extreme fast learning. The efficient Fast S-transform(FST) is imposed to extract discriminating features of different power quality disturbances wave form and that correspondence feature will be given as input of the ELM classifier and further proceed for classification. By this process performance of FST based ELM classifier is compared with the ST based ELM classifier with distinctive features of different PQ disturbances. FST signal analysis is done by using different classifier and corresponding result is found out. Ten varieties of PQ disturbances have been chosen for the proposed classification task. The proposed FST based ELM classification is feasible and promising for a real time application as evidenced from our results.

Author Keywords: S-Transform, Fast-S-Transform, Extreme Learning Machine, R-ELM

articleTitle: Text Summarization: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In today's era, there are large numbers of documents or information that is present related to any particular field. There are many sources out of which we can gather a lot much information that will be pertinent to our field of search. Much information is available at various sources like the internet or various books. But, as we know that a huge amount of information cannot be always considered or taken into use. So, a precise amount of information is always considered and that information is drawn out from the original document that is huge in size. In other words, we can say that we pluck out the summary of the main document. A summary of any document is defined as a collection of essential data by collecting the brief statements accounting the main points of the original document. Therefore, Summarization of a text is a procedure of separating or getting the relevant data out of a very large document. It is the process of shortening the text document by using various technologies and methodologies to create a coherent summary including the major points of the original document. There are various methods by which the summarization process can be carried out.

Author Keywords: Text summarization, summary types, summarization methods, summary evaluation

articleTitle: Selection of Cost-Effective Prime Source towards Possible Uses in Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This work reports a systematic investigation towards the probable selection of cost-effective prime source to facilitate enhanced Quality of Services (QoS) in Fog Computing. Among several ones, Elementary Cellular Automata (ECA) based prime generation was found suitable towards its possible consideration in real life application modeling. Detailed investigation explores the advantages of ECA based model as a cost-effective model in Fog Computing as low-cost hardware implementation, and low energy necessity may be ensured with ECA based models.

Author Keywords: Fog Computing, Application Provisioning, Group Signatures Set of Primes, Cellular Automata

articleTitle: Research on Entity Semantic Relation Extraction in Fusion Domain
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Entity relationship extraction is one of the important research topics in the field of information extraction, this paper proposes an improved method for extracting entity semantic relations based on tree kernel function, by adding domain knowledge syntax tree and entity semantic information to improve the performance of relation extraction. This method needs to build a domain knowledge tree that reflects the semantic relationship of entities in a particular domain, pruning and denoising the knowledge tree and merging it into the syntax tree to get the domain-specific entity semantic tree. Then, a classification model of entity relationship is constructed to achieve the extraction of domain entity relations. The relationship extraction experiments were conducted on 1500 collected data from tourism domain, the results show that the proposed method is better than the method that does not integrate into the domain knowledge tree. The F value increased by 7.3%.

Author Keywords: domain knowledge tree, syntax tree, entity relation extraction, tree kernel function, support vector machine

articleTitle: A Review on Rule-Based and Hybrid Stemming Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Reducing a word to its original form called stemming is extremely important in the field of natural language processing, especially to develop morphological analyzer and information retrieval systems. Use of stemming has decreased the dimension of indexing. Stemming algorithms are developed during last few decades to automate the process requires different approaches as it is mostly language specific. In this paper we have discussed and given a comparative view about different stemming approaches developed so far. It focuses mainly on four stemming techniques namely Rulebased, Statistical, Hybrid and Unsupervised approach.

Author Keywords: Rule-based stemmer, hybrid stemmer, suffix stripping, porter stemmer

articleTitle: CFSES Optimization Feature Selection with Neural Network Classification for Microarray Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The DNA microarray data are enabling to measure the countenance levels of genes simultaneously, so long as an excessive for tuitous for cancer prediction. The number of features or genes is often more than thousands but in another side, the number of instances or subjects is less than hundreds. For that, it is required and vital to perform gene selection for classification. Feature selection moderates this problem by eradicating irrelevant genes or features from data. So it optimizes the computational cost with concentrated data. At here, we propose a new methodology for feature selection to determine marker genes that are relevant to a type of cancer. A different bio-stimulated procedure entitled as CFSES (Correlation-based Feature Selection Elephant Search) is projected in this work. We use the Linear Support Vector Machine (Linear-SVM), SMO-SVM and MLP to make classification with use of the selected marker genes. The performance of marker gene selection and classification are illustrated in two real data analysis.

Author Keywords: Correlation based Feature Selection (CFS), Elephant search Algorithm (ESA), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), SVM, Microarray Data

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Facilities Location Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As an important part of the logistics system, logistics facilities are related to the efficiency and economic benefit of the logistics system. A scientific and reasonable location can effectively reduce the cost of goods, save the time of distribution, and improve the efficiency of the whole logistics system. There are many methods for the location of logistics facilities, such as cross median model, gravity model, Wolf model and his bow. Location problem based on quantitative and qualitative models has gradually become a research focus in the field of logistics. The location of logistics facilities is influenced and restricted by many factors, such as transportation cost, construction cost, land rent and operation cost. Therefore, in the location decision of the multi center logistics facilities, we should solve the problem of building several and where it is built, and the construction quantity and construction address determine the efficiency and cost of the whole logistics system to a great extent. In this paper, in view of the complex calculation process of multi center of gravity method in the logistics network planning and the large amount of work and difficulty, a multi center of gravity logistics location algorithm based on GIS is designed. The algorithm applies GIS's powerful data management, spatial analysis and visualization functions, and realizes it in GIS environment. Finally, the algorithm is applied in combination with specific examples.

articleTitle: A Method of Automatically Identifying Learners' Help-Seeking Behavior Classifications in Online Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the online learning environment, identifying learners' behaviors in the learning process can help them improve their learning effect autonomously. Firstly, we use K-Means algorithm to cluster the learner's help-seeking behavior data to get the classification label of the learner's help-seeking behavior. Secondly, we use the t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding(T-sne) algorithm to reduce the dimension of the data to visualize the clustering result. Finally, the learner's help-seeking behavior data and the help-seeking behavior classification labels are used as training data to train the Naive Bayesian model so as to automatically obtain the help-seeking behavior classification for the data generated by the new learner. Via the analysis and processing of the help-seeking behavior data using the method proposed in this paper, it shows that this method can effectively find online learners' help-seeking behavior classifications.

articleTitle: The Design of Flexible Workflow in Scientific Research Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In scientific research management projects, if the process model changes, without a workflow technology, the codes need to be modified and the workload of modification will increase significantly. After introducing a flexible workflow technology, what can be done is to directly define the new process model. This paper mainly introduces ECA rules on the basis of workflow meta-model to design a flexible workflow: the ECA rules will express execution logics of the basic workflow, and the basic elements of the process model in the approval process of scientific research projects will be represented by ECA. The design of the flexible workflow in scientific research management system will include flexible workflow engine and the process approval platform for scientific research project management with ECA rule analysis. The flexible workflow implemented in this paper can better guide the workflow engine to adapt to the current environment, and decide the different execution process according to the specific process instance contexts. The method proposed in this paper better supports the needs of scientific research project management.

Author Keywords: workflow, flexible workflow, ECA rules, process approval, software architecture

articleTitle: Research on Color Expansion Method in Clothing Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: According to the problem of too few basic color cases given by experts in the clothing recommendation system, we find more similar colors of clothing recommended to users based on the color similarity calculation combined with RGB and HSV color space. The conversion of three-color representations by PANTONE, RGB and HSV is suitable for computer processing. On the basis of defining the space constraints of color expansion in each color type, we use color similarity calculation for color expansion. The computer programming simulation experiment shows that each color type is regular on the three dimensions of the RGB color space. Under experimental conditions, a single basic color case can expand to 300 similar colors, and the expansion results can be sorted according to the color similarity. The color similarity calculation method introduced in this paper can avoid the weakness of RGB color space inhomogeneous, and the calculation is simple. The method conforms to the rule of visual similarity judgment which is adapted to the expert's recommendation.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Underground Pipeline Typical Accidents and Numerical Simulation Research
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The paper analyzes the characteristics of underground pipeline accident and searches hidden danger of underground pipelines, adopts the method of safety system engineering to analyze the influencing factors of the underground pipeline, applies the method of mathematical statistics to deeply deal with the cause and mechanism of the accidents from the distribution of the pipeline type, the accident type of single pipeline, combined with the case analysis of the direct cause of the typical accidents, in view of the underground pipeline under the dynamic vehicle load, we have a simulation of the local stress response of the pipe, then give corresponding professional and technical conclusions, which provides the replacement time base for the pipeline, then the safety management work of the underground pipeline is further discussed.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Acceptance Inspection Sampling: Combining Incentives with Policy Optimization for Process Improvement
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The cost of acceptance inspection sampling is an important criterion in evaluating inspection schemes as well as a major reason for sampling inspection being considered more efficient than overall inspection. In this paper, we examine economic cost of a single-sample plan and discuss the cost drivers. Specifically, Acceptance Number (A) and Sample Size (n) are the decision variables of the sample plan that provides incentive for producers to alter their quality level. We discover that manufacturers may have incentives to improve or reduce control of product quality by changing acceptance sampling schemes due to impact of economic parameters.

Author Keywords: Acceptance sampling, economic incentives, process improvement, operations analytics

articleTitle: Classification of Ventricular Arrhythmias Using DWT Based VMD Features
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Ventricular fibrillation (VF) and ventricular tachycardia (VT) are the foremost reason of sudden cardiac deaths which can be cured by the timely application of automated external defibrillators (AEDs) by identifying the sternness of cardiac arrhythmias using complex algorithms. Since heart disease is a chronical disease which cannot be cured permanently, hence an early prediction of these diseases is very much crucial. In this work, we have suggested a novel algorithm using DWT based VMD features. Primarily, DWT has been applied on the ECG signal using Daubechies db6 mother wavelet to decompose it up to 8th level. Then on each level, the VMD algorithm has been applied to extract a set of 15 time-frequency features. The computed features are then used for identification and precise classification of VT, VF, and normal rhythm. This feature set was authenticated with the estimated data available in the CUDB and VFDB database obtained from PhysioNet database. The proposed algorithm results in an accuracy of 99.13% in CVR classifier and 93.88% in SVM classifier. The results show that the t-f data representations that are fed to the classifiers provide superior performance values.

Author Keywords: Ventricular fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia, electrocardiogram, discrete wavelet transform, variational mode decomposition, feature extraction, classification

articleTitle: Impact of Real Estate Industry on the National Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The real estate industry is major part of China's national economy. From the perspective of national economic accounting, taking Shenzhen as an example, we analyzed the trend of real estate prices in the context of the "double-limit" policy and the impact of the real estate industry on the national economy.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of 11.2 kW PV System under Variable Field Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) generating systems are widely used for renewable power generation all over the world. The PV system produces the non-linear characteristics curves under the normal operating conditions. However, the PV system faces tremendous challenges while delivering maximum power in the field conditions. The challenges involve variation of solar insolation, temperature rise and variation in series and shunt resistance. During these conditions, the characteristics curve of the system changes resulting decrease in power output. In this paper, a mathematical modeling of 280W PV module is carried out in MATLAB/Simulink environment. An 11.2 kW PV system is modeled using a number of 280W PV modules. The 11.2 kW system has been tested for its behavioral study under various environmental and field conditions. The study shows that the output power of the system varies with respect to the variation of environmental and field condition.

Author Keywords: Solar Photovoltaic, temperature, irradiance, shunt resistance, series resistance

articleTitle: Erbium Doped Asymmetric Clad Leakage Channel Fibers for Large Mode Area and Low Bending Loss Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Though the design and use of fiber has proven its high capacity and data rate, still the scope is open to enhance its quality. Similarly loss is a major factor for consideration. In this paper, we design a modified leakage channel fiber (LCF) for large mode area application. It is of26 Erbium doped silica rods used as asymmetric clad that can maintain large mode area even in bending condition. The fundamental mode of the proposed design is 1700 μm2, at 1064nm under straight condition. The effective mode area is considered that shrinks to 998 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with the condition of bending radius of 15 cm. In straight condition the fundamental mode (FM) and higher order mode (HOM) losses are 0.0007dB/m and 0.0093dB/m, respectively. The differential loss ratio between FM and HOM found 12.07. This proves the effective operation of fiber in single mode.

Author Keywords: fiber lasers, large mode area, LCF, Asymmetric cladding, FM, HOM, Bending loss

articleTitle: The Impact of Private Enterprises' Participation in State-Owned Enterprises Mixed Ownership Reform on Corporate Performance under the Background of Sharing Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the panel data of 31 Provinces and 905 state-owned listed enterprises in 2006-2016, this paper uses Regression Model to study the impact of private enterprises' participation in state-owned enterprises mixed ownership reform on corporate performance under the background of sharing economy. The results show that there is a big difference between the governance structure of state-owned enterprises and private enterprises. In state-owned enterprises, the ownership concentration has a positive impact on the performance. Sharing ownership and control rights of the private enterprises' participation in state-owned enterprises mixed ownership reform has a positive impact on the performance. Therefore, based on the study, the author proposes targeted policy recommendations for the promotion of mixed ownership reform.

Author Keywords: private enterprises' participation in state-owned enterprises mixed ownership reform

articleTitle: Teaching Design of "Access Database Technology and Application" Based on Flipped Classroom
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Through the practice teaching for nearly eleven years, it is found that one of the common problems in the course of teaching is the negative attitude of students in practice. The database course is a course with strong practice, combine the theory and practice of content, need more time to practice the operation, based on the non-computer professional students as teaching objects, "Access database technology and application" for teaching case, to flip the classroom as the main teaching tools to solve the ubiquitous the problem.

articleTitle: The Role of Ethical Leadership in Brand Image Building and Cost Reduction through the Adoption of Green Practices: A Path Analysis Using SEM
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This study investigated the role of ethical leadership in brand image building and firms’ end-to-end operations cost reduction through the implementation of green practices. This research employed SEM (Structural Equation Modelling) for testing hypothesis, while data were collected from the Indian electronics’ products manufacturers. The findings revealed that the role of ethical leadership is very important in improving brand image and customer trust through adopting green practices, while green practices is negatively correlated with end-to-end firms’ cost reduction due to scarcity of green technology and green suppliers in Indian market. In addition, most companies import green materials and technologies from European countries, which incur huge costs in terms of long lead times. This research also discussed research implications and future research area.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of AlGaAs/InGaAs/GaAs Based Pseudomorphic HEMT Using SILVACO ATLASTM
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The High Electron Mobility Transistor (HEMT) is a field effect transistor which is used to give very high performance at microwave and radio frequencies, exhibiting a low noise figure. The HEMT works on the principle of formation of Two Dimensional Electron Gas (2DEG) where there are very less electron collisions. In this work we have designed and observed the characteristics of a Pseudomorphic HEMT (P-HEMT) with an AlGaAs supply layer, InGaAs channel layer and a GaAs substrate which is of p-type. The output characteristics curve (ID-VDS), transfer characteristics curve, transconductance (gm) and cutoff frequency (fT) have been observed. A transconductance of 281.296mS/mm, threshold voltage V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub> = -1.1V at V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</sub> = 6V and a cut-off frequency of 18GHz can be easily seen from the simulation result of the HEMT. The design is simulated using SILVACO ATLAS.

Author Keywords: Pseudomorphic HEMTs , transconductance , unity current gain cutoff frequency

articleTitle: Design and Development for Smart Home Control System Based on WeChat Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the development and infiltration of the Internet of things technology and artificial intelligence technology, the smart home system has begun to provide convenient and comfortable intelligence living environment for people. This paper discusses the design and development of smart home control system which is based on the WeChat platform. The smart home control system can provide lots of control modes for appliances, such as voice, text messages and the UI interface. It is simple and user-friendly. The results show that our system overcomes the deficiencies of the current ones in the market.

articleTitle: Correction of MEU Errors in AES Using Multi Bit Errors Correction Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Comprehensive design efforts are needed for implementing algorithms onto an embedded system, which generally have a low power and area budget as well as high throughput requirement. Another important criterion of such systems is fault resiliency, which help them to perform in a robust environment. The general motivation in this direction is to have the general purpose instructions to be taken care by the software, whereas specialized hardware blocks are used to accelerate the execution of complex blocks. It also serves as a good target for embedded applications due to availability of general purpose CPU as well as other needed functional blocks in form of soft cores and dedicated resources (hard cores). Radiation induced faults resulting to single event upsets (SEU) and multiple event upsets (MEU), intentional attacker etc. Though a good number of research work exists on detecting errors for crypto-hardware but very few works can found on error correction using hardware techniques. In this paper, we present a novel crypto-hardware design involving BCH error detection code.

Author Keywords: BCH code, AES, Crypto Hardware, FPGA

articleTitle: A Modified Timing Metric for Timing Synchronization in NC-OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the classical method of timing synchronization in OFDM system, data on regular spaced subcarriers are transmitted. However, the concept of data transmission on regular spaced subcarriers does not fulfil the requirement of cognitive radio in achieving spectral holes free from interference from the primary users. So, Non Continuous OFDM is investigated for Cognitive Radio. Several synchronization schemes have been explored for OFDM system. However, these schemes are not suitable for NC OFDM system as it utilizes few deactivated sub carriers. In this letter a new timing synchronization scheme with modified timing metric is proposed for NC-OFDM suitable for cognitive radio system. The performance of the proposed timing synchronization scheme is compared with the traditional Park and Zhang schemes.

articleTitle: Study on the Pricing and Issue Scale of Marine Catastrophe Bonds
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The marine catastrophe always causes huge losses, and it is easy for insurance companies to go bankrupt when they take on catastrophic insurance. To ensure the normal operation of insurance companies and effectively manage catastrophic risks, catastrophe bonds can be designed to transfer risks to the capital market. Based on the fat-tailed characteristics of catastrophic loss data, the POT model is used to study the marine catastrophe loss data. Firstly estimate the parameters of generalized Pareto distribution of marine catastrophe losses; secondly design and price the marine catastrophe bonds by using non-life insurance actuarial science techniques, then estimate the bond issuance scale by the total expected value of bond claims.

Author Keywords: generalized Pareto distribution, bonds, marine catastrophe risk

articleTitle: Simulation for Induction Heating in Forging Preheating
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Summarizing the physics laws and analyzing the cause of the "skin effect", an industrial induction process reduces to a mathematic model, which can be solved by the finite element analysis. The distribution of the electric current and the temperature at different times is also investigated. Furthermore, two sets of different processing parameters are compared and the advantages and disadvantages of each choice are discussed according to the numerical results. Finally, all the detail data in simulation are obtained to provide a reference for the industrial forging preheating.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Solvency Adequacy Ratio for Small and Medium-Sized Non-Life Insurance Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the gradual expansion of our insurance company business, the risks are increasing, and the problem of insolvency of insurance companies is becoming apparent. Therefore, the research on the solvency adequacy ratio has become one of the hot topics in the academic field. Since the commissioning of the second generation solvency supervision system (C-ROSS) in 2015, a series of changes have taken place in the solvency of insurance companies. This paper firstly applied the data of 50 groups of small and medium-sized non life insurance companies from 2010 to 2014 based on the new changes after the C-ROSS trial operation to analyze the internal factors of solvency adequacy by using the data of 40 groups of them based on the multivariate statistical analysis. Then, the validity of the model was verified by 10 other groups of data. Through verification, the model can describe the solvency adequacy rate of small and medium-sized non-life insurance companies in China well. Finally, some meaningful policy suggestions were put forward.

articleTitle: Energy Cognizant Broadcasting in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: (WNs) Wireless Networks are increasingly becoming an importance of the next generation network infrastructure. This is possible because of the availability of the inexpensive wireless devices such as Bluetooth and wireless LANs. In this paper we have discussed the five different energy cognizant metric based on the energy consumption at the nodes in case of broadcast routing in wireless ad hoc networks. We have shown that using these metrics in an energy cognizant broadcast algorithm, reduces the cost of routing packets to all the destinations by 5%-50% over a broadcast tree. The tree is constructed using a greedy strategy based on network topology information only. By using this energy cognizant algorithm, the maximum node cost after many broadcast is reduced by 20 to 150% compared to non-energy cognizant algorithm, thereby increasing the life of the networks. We have run simulation with the flooding algorithm for broadcasting and we have observed that it has performed 10 times better when energy cognizant algorithm is used as compared to non-energy cognizant algorithm.

Author Keywords: WNs (Wireless Networks), LANs (Local Area Networks), IoT(Internet of Things), MRMC (Multi Radio Multi Channel), ECMAS (Energy Cognizant Multiple Access Protocol with Signaling)

articleTitle: Study of Electrical Series Resistance of IMPATT Diode in Ka Band
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Measurement of electrical series resistance (RS) of an IMPATT diode is very essential, because when it is higher than the negative resistance of the device, then the oscillation will cease. Thus the objective of this paper is to analyze the relationship exist among RS of Ka-band SDR-IMPATT diode, the oscillatory threshold current (Ith) and the designated frequency (fsh). The fsh and the Ith of Ka-band SDR-IMPATT diode is measured experimentally and the value of RS obtained has a very good agreement with manufacturer's data. The results show that the proposed method is able to compute the RS of an IMPATT diode.

Author Keywords: IMPATT Diode, Ka Band, Series Resistance, SDR, Susceptance
