articleTitle: Analysis on Influencing Factors of Strawberry Purchasing in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The consumers in Beijing are taken as the main research objects in this paper to study the impacts of different factors on strawberry purchasing, and the strawberry consumption data is obtained based on the field survey and the descriptive statistics show that the consumer mainly focuses on the taste and ignores the brand in strawberry purchasing; the high price and losing freshness are the main reasons that the consumers are not willing to purchase the strawberry. Based on the research, it is found that the strawberry producers have the following problems, such as high strawberry pricing, improper selection of promotion method and marketing channel etc. As for these problems, it is proposed that the competition-orientated pricing method can be selected, the discount promotion and price-off promotion method can be adopted in the strawberry sales process and the greengrocery shall be given preference for marketing channel etc.

articleTitle: Brand Development for International Businesses in OBOR Countries — Take Romberg-Sersa Rail Group and Huawei as Case Study
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The main aim of this project was to explore the opportunities that One Belt One Road (OBOR) presents to companies to develop their international brands, and to point out some ofthe risks and challenges that come along. Using a multiple case study methodology, secondary data was collected and reviewed to explain what OBOR offers to Romberg-Sersa Rail Group and Huawei companies. It was discovered that excellent opportunities exist for both companies to expand into new markets in the OBOR region. On the other hand, there are also potential risks and challenges. The paper concludes that the companies take advantage of the opportunities presented, but also take precautions and consider the risks and challenges.

articleTitle: A Cognitive Study of Tibetan Lhasa Speech Emotional Rhythm Based on Emotional Rhythm and Emotional Lexical Meaning
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper is based on the ERP technology to study the emotional rhythm cognition mechanism of Tibetan Lhasa dialect in Emotional rhythm and emotional word matching. It was found that in the 150ms-250ms sad rhythm level, the titers mismatch stimulus pairs versus the titers-matched stimulus pairs induced a more positive N300. And this P200 effect was widely distributed in the scalp. In the 250 ms-350 ms time window, titers mismatch stimulus pairs versus the titers-matched stimulus pairs induced a more negative N300, and the distribution of brain area of this N300 effect was affected by the rhythm titers. When the background was happy rhythm, the N300 effect was distributed throughout the scalp area. When the background was sad rhythm, the N300 effect mainly occurred in the front and middle of the scalp. The 350ms-550ms time window, emotional rhythm and lexical titers mismatched stimulus pairs versus titers-matched stimulus pairs induced a more negative N400, manifested as a double-sided effect across the entire scalp distribution, and it was not affected by the rhythm titers. In addition, the response components including the P2 and N400 effected were more pronounced in sad rhythm. This was probably due to the fact that negative stimuli such as sad rhythm were more likely to attract the attention of individuals and required more psychological resources.

articleTitle: Meta-Analysis of Chromium and Pig Reproduction
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Chromium is ubiquitous; it is found in humans, animals, and the environment as it circulates through crops, animal feed, animals, manure, and soil. Chromium has also been used in pig feed. Chromium is reported to improve pig reproduction, but studies are conflicting, so we conducted a meta-analysis of 312 records. We found that chromium did not affect pig litter size and piglet weight. Chromium is useful in animal husbandry, but excessive chromium can significantly inhibit plant growth. This meta-analysis suggests that pig farms should supplement chromium to pigs as needed based on feed chromium content.

articleTitle: A Study on the Early Processing of the Tones of Monosyllabic Words in Tibetan Lhasa Dialect
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This study used the tone of Tibetan Lhasa dialect as the research object. The Oddball paradigm stimulation with 55 tone as the standard stimulus was designed. When the deviant stimulus 53 tone, 13 tone and 114 tone were randomly presented in the sequence, the ERP induced by the deviant stimulus of the brain in the front attention stage had a significant negative deflection compared to the ERP induced by the standard stimulus. And there was a larger mismatch negativity in the left brain auditory cortex than in the right brain auditory cortex. This result was consistent with the results of studies on patients with brain damage, that is, lexical tone processing showed a left hemisphere advantage.

Author Keywords: Tibetan Lhasa dialect, monosyllabic words, tone, cognitive processing

articleTitle: Strength Analysis of Jip Structure of Wrecker Rescue Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In recent years, China's transportation industry has developed rapidly, the number of vehicles has increased significantly, but road traffic accidents also have increased. The rescue vehicle plays an important role in dealing with sudden road traffic accidents. The jip structure is one of its typical working mechanisms. For the application and design requirements of a specific wrecker rescue vehicle in practice, a three-dimensional model of the jip structure is built using software. Through the strength analysis of the jip structure under typical working conditions of 60° full shrinkage and full extension, the jip structure's maximum stress meets the design requirements. As the key component of wrecker rescue vehicle, the research results of jip structure has enhanced the lifting capacity of the equipment and expanded the use of road clearing and rescue vehicles, and moreover, provided meaningful research cases for the rapid treatment of road accidents.

articleTitle: Social Contact Experience Design for Sports APP
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the development of economy and the increase of income, people pay much attention to improving the quality of material life, and pay more attention to how to improve their health level through sports. Although sports are often personalized or small team, sports can also create social topics for social activities. For sports APP, sports social contact is an important part of improving the product experience. This article analyzes why the movement needs to be sociable; what is the characteristics of the current sports APP social contact; finally, a new idea of the design of a new sports social experience is put forward.

articleTitle: Improvement of Dynamic Stability of VSC-HVDC System, Using Runner Roots Algorithm Based Robust Control Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The VSC-HVDC based power system is widely used for transmission of huge power over long distance (above 500Km). During any fault in the power system at any location, the stability is highly affected and it needs some robust controller to settle the system quickly in to original condition. Regularly PI controllers have been used for this purpose in much research work. Here one prominent robust controller known as sliding mode controller is applied in this work. But one of the demerits of this controller is proper selection of controller gains. Here by the use of optimized robust controller gains the stability further may be improved. The wild goat algorithm is applied here to get optimized value of controller gains. a simple two machine power system (shown in Figure.1) is simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK software and it's outcome are plotted in the following graphs. The results depict the performance of wild Goat based sliding mode controller, is far better than conventional PI and sliding mode controller.

Author Keywords: VSC-HVDC link, robust control, SMC and Wild Goat optimization

articleTitle: Key Simulating Technique Analysis for BIW Welding Process
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Process simulation is a bridge connecting process planning and layout and debugging of production line, providing virtualized simulation technique support for product process verification and process scheme analysis. This paper combines the experiences and results of several process simulation projects, defines the process simulation concept, intervention point, analysis scope, input and output, clearly explains the technical support content and form of process simulation, and investigates in details the procedure, equipment definition, man-machine simulation, etc. It puts forward the practical standard procedure of process simulation for the welding process planning and steps of simulation. According to the actual welding concurrent engineering project, the related problems and the solutions are discussed.

articleTitle: How Does RMB Exchange Rate Fluctuations Affect Workers' Wages
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Pay levels of enterprise employees, as well as skilled and unskilled premiums, could directly impact on market stability. The general level of the exchange rate, would eventually change factors substitution through changing the prices of factors. By sorting out existing literature, this paper attempts to find ways to influence the exchange rate changes affecting the enterprise workers' wages and wage gaps of skilled workers and unskilled workers in order to provide reference for subsequent research.

articleTitle: Short Term Photo Voltaic Power Prediction Using R-ELM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In present days the power system, face many challenges like fall of generation, shortage of fossil fuels, enverniomental pollution and increase of energy demand. The above challenges encouraged the need of renewable resources which is highly emerging area in twenty first century. Specifically the solar energy generation has taken an important part in the present power scenario. Solar power generation fluctuates because of interference of temperature and irradiance. Given significant uncertainties concerned in PV power production, forecasting gives a novel result for the reservations and fluctuations in solar data. Proper and consistent PV power calculation is important to maintain performance of the power system. In this paper a recurrent ELM is applied for PV power forecasting followed by empirical mode decomposition (EMD). A set of non stationary historical time series data is decomposed first to different intrinsic mode functions (IMF) and then fed to RELM.

articleTitle: Preliminary Research on Methods of Conformance Evaluation of Enterprise Self-Declaration Standards
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper mainly focus on existing problems in self-declaration of Enterprise Product and Service Standards, studies the content, method and process for the conformance evaluation of enterprise self-declaration standards, analyzes the existing problems and the causes in the enterprise self-declaration standards through specific cases, and puts forward some suggestions to the work for the conformance evaluation of enterprise self-declaration standards.

articleTitle: A Guided Approach to Prioritize Object-Oriented Test Suites Using MC/DC Testing
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Concolic testing is used to prioritize test suites generated from object oriented programs. Various techniques proposed and validated to prioritize test cases at the maintenance phase of software system. But to prioritize test suites generated from object-oriented safety critical programs is a new challenge. MC/DC ("Modified Condition Decision Coverage") testing criteria is a well-known technique for testing safety critical systems. We propose a method to prioritize the given test suites using MC/DC criteria. In this paper, concolic testing is applied on several standard Java programs to generate test suites and recorded their execution time. The generated test suites are used by a coverage analyzer to measure MC/DC%. MC/DC score and time taken for each test suite are formulated to produce weight value for each test suite, which in turn helps to achieve prioritized test suites.

Author Keywords: Concolic Testing, Test Suite Prioritization, MC/DC criteria, Symbolic execution

articleTitle: A Novel Parameterized Activation Function in Visual Geometry Group
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In this paper, by setting the recognition accuracy and the running time as selecting standards, and studying the performances of four activation functions, namely, standard rectified linear unit (ReLU), exponential linear unit (ELU), scaled exponential linear unit (SELU) and Softplus in visual geometry group (VGG) network. A novel parameterized activation function, which is based on a combination of the advantages of both ReLU and Softplus, has been proposed, compared and tested in VGG network with a selected dataset. The test results show that the novel activation function improves the recognition accuracy in VGG effectively, and even at around 3.0% when the parameter k is larger than 1.37.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Rate of Regional Production Insurance: A Case of Wheat in Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: the comprehensive utilization of wavelet analysis (WT), NAR neural network and kernel density estimation (KDE) method is used to determine the regional production insurance premium in Shandong province. The empirical results show that the NAR neural network has better effect on the trend yield, and it can effectively improve the accuracy of crop rate determination. The wheat insurance premium calculated under the level of 85%-95% protection is lower than the current rate in Shandong.

articleTitle: WTM: An Interlinking Medium for Student Teacher Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In today's scenario Recommender systems have become increasingly popular in recent years, and are utilized in a variety of areas including movies, music, news, books, research articles, search queries, social tags, and products in general. Mostly used in the digital domain, majority of today's E-Commerce sites like eBay, Amazon, Alibaba etc. make use of their proprietary recommendation algorithms in order to better serve the customers with the products they are bound to like. But the most interesting thing is that these recommendation systems are no longer limited to only product or service recommendation. People can also be recommended by using such systems. And it can be applied to solve the biggest problem of the newbie in an institution. The central focus of this paper is to build an application that would take into account the desired field of specialization of the student (especially newbie) and give him or her recommendation of a teacher or senior of the same institution (school or college). The main objective of this paper to take the existing recommendation system into account and make a fusion to give a better sort recommendation subsequently breaking the wall of unawareness and unconsciousness between student and teacher.

Author Keywords: recommendation system, content based recommendation system, naïve recommendation system, collaborative filtering engine

articleTitle: Application of Heterogeneous Multi-Criteria Decision Making in the Financial Analysis for Manufacturing Company
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Financial conditions can reflect the economic development of manufacturing companies in the past, present and future. The analysis of corporate financial conditions can help to provide information and evidence for decision-making. Therefore, the financial analysis method which is helpful to make decision has been widely concerned by scholars. However, the indexes that reflect the financial condition of the company not only may be clear numbers, but also may be non-numerical information which cannot be represented by the exact value. In order to solve the problem that most existing methods didn't take the fuzzy value and the actual value into consideration, the heterogeneous multi criteria decision (MCDM) is applied to analyze the financial condition of the manufacturing enterprises in this paper. The proposed method employs fuzzy theory to improve extant financial index system and considers quantitative and qualitative attributes, which may leads heterogeneous information, such as real numbers, interval numbers and triangular fuzzy numbers. Furthermore the proposed method determines companies ordering by using TOPSIS based on their total financial condition. Moreover, based on the comparison between these companies, different aspects of the financial conditions can be analyzed in detail. Finally, a case study is conducted to verify the proposed method can effectively analyze the financial conditions of manufacturing companies.

articleTitle: Investigation on Effects of Slotting in a Microstrip-Fed Rectangular Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the effect of slot on a microstrip-fed rectangular patch antenna. This was done using Ansoft's HFSS to study how the slots affect the return loss, indicating the performance of the antenna at notch frequencies. The placement of the slots may help in tuning the antenna, and improving the bandwidth and gain of the antenna.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Online Learning System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In today's Internet+ era, more and more e-learning platforms have appeared in the eyes of the public. The emergence of big data also points a development path for the learning platform. By analyzing the latest research progress and existing problems of many learning platforms, an online learning system with learning feedback is proposed. The system consists of a learning subsystem and a feedback subsystem. The learning subsystem is designed based on the basic needs of students. The feedback subsystem uses clustering algorithms and some calculation formulas to analyze student learning behaviors and display them in the summary report to the teacher. Teachers can adjust the teaching plan according to the summary report.

articleTitle: On the Strategy of Leaders' Executive Power Improvement
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Execution is the key to successful organization. Based on the description of the concept, classification, and constituent elements of executive power, the article analyzes the factors affecting execution and the causes of poor execution, and proposes several strategies for improving the execution of leaders.

articleTitle: A Cognitive Study of Tibetan Language Lhasa Speech Rhythm Based on Titers Valuation of Emotional Words
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper is based on the ERP technology to study the emotional rhythm cognition mechanism of Tibetan Lhasa dialect in emotional lexical titers assessment. It was found that in the 250ms-350ms phase, the titers mismatch stimulus pairs versus the titers matched stimulus pairs induced a more negative N300. This double-sided N300 effect changed with rhythm titers. The 350ms-550ms time window, emotional rhythm and lexical titers mismatched stimulus pairs versus titers matched stimulus pairs induced a more negative N400, manifested as a double-sided effect across the entire scalp distribution. In the middle and later stages, the left hemisphere also incorporates the process of cognitive processing in which emotional rhythm regulates the meaning of emotional words, indicating that cognitive processing of emotional rhythms is also a perception model including several subsystems in space.

Author Keywords: Tibetan Lhasa dialect, emotional words, rhythm cognition, ERP technology

articleTitle: Analysis of Application and Distribution of Lead in M1 Type Automotive Materials
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper systematically analyzes the application of lead in M1 type automotive materials of more than 2500 types in 2016 and 2017, and studies the application of lead in automotive materials in terms of six aspects, such as average lead quantity, different series, different types, traditional/new-energy automobiles, risk coefficient of lead in high-risk parts, distribution of lead in exempted material and so on. This paper provides the data support for automobile industry by comparing and analysis of lead distribution form.

articleTitle: Building Housing by the Mode of Crowd-Funding
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Building housing by the mode of crowd-funding can reduce not only the cost of home buyers, but also the cost of financing and sales for developers. The key to success is whether the planning scheme of building housing is reasonable or not. On the basis of thinking about the ROI and the satisfaction degree of home buyers, a linear programming optimization model is established in this paper, and it gives us the optimal planning scheme that can be executed. The calculation results show that the optimized planning scheme has increased the ratio of return on investment and reduced the floor area ratio. This mathematical model can be used for reference in other crowd-funding projects.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Relationship between Sleep Quality and Impact Indicators Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: We get the preliminary correlation between the each impact indicator and sleep quality by the Spearman's rank correlation coefficient. Among them, Character index can not be tested, the Reliability indicator was significantly lower. In order to improve the stability of the sample, we select sample data in the Reliability>30 and conduct gradually correlation analysis. The result is that the Character indicator correlation become lower, but the Reliability indicator correlation become higher. We carry on the data mining to the sample and conduct correlation verification and the analysis to it. The results showed that the correlation between the Character indicator and Sleep quality was poor and the results of the first correlation analysis were accurate, so we ignored it .Next, we randomly select 70% sample data, and construct the ordered multiple classification logistic regression model between Sleep quality and related indicators . The remaining 30% data are used to test the equation. According to the model we built, it is found that people are more likely to have sleep problems as they get older, especially for middle-aged and elderly women, maintaining a good mental state every day is the key to ensuring sleep quality.

Author Keywords: Ordered multiple classification logistic regression model

articleTitle: Improvement of Hedging on Stock Price Volatility Based on Fundamental Securities in Emerging Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The stock price volatility in emerging financial markets could be hedged by some innovative financial engineering methods without derivatives. In this paper, it is explored how to apply the principle of portfolio to hedge stock price volatility risk in emerging financial markets like China. This hedging portfolio involves the stock and a zero-coupon bond that deducting from the former. This portfolio can effectively eliminate stock price volatility and empirical results show that 91.74% of the risk is removed.

articleTitle: The State of Online SR Reporting at New Zealand Universities
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This study examines the current status of online social responsibility (SR) reporting by New Zealand universities. In this study, we selected all eight publicly funded universities as sample. Content analysis of university websites was the research method. In the course of research, we employed an assessment framework for online SR reporting, developed by Sánchez et al. [1], as an instrument for content analysis. The results reveal that New Zealand universities perform well for online SR reporting in general, from both the content and the context. It is argued that New Zealand universities should have a strong commitment in communicating their SR initiatives with various stakeholders via internet. As an exploratory study in the New Zealand higher education context, this research makes some contributions to the extant literature in the area.

articleTitle: Quality Improvements in Online Education System by Using Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the present era online education has become one of the popular higher education alternatives. With the busy and competitive life-style it continues to expanding. This gave rise a need for determining and maintaining the quality in the process of designing, developing and delivering online education. In traditional Face-To-Face teaching method it is easier for a faculty to monitor the performance of a student. In online learning it is difficult to monitor a student's performance. That is why there is a requirement for a prediction system. The suggested dropout prediction system helps in tracking student progress in the course and acts as an alert system for the teacher to improve student's performance in the course. The prediction can be done by clustering algorithms like Random forest, C4.5.

Author Keywords: Online education system, Random forest, C4.5, CART, Principal Component Analysis, Area Under Curve

articleTitle: Research on Speed Identification Technology in Direct Torque Control of Asynchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The application of an improved speed identification method based on MRAS in direct torque control system of asynchronous motor is studied. A highpass filter is introduced in the voltage model to eliminate the pure integration effect, and the same filter is introduced in the current model to balance the phase and amplitude deviation. Aiming at the influence of filter cut-off frequency and stator resistance on flux observation precision, fuzzy controller is used to adjust the cut-off frequency and stator resistance on-line to eliminate the influence of both on flux observation and improve the speed identification accuracy.

articleTitle: The Current Status and Circulation Characteristics of Chinese Tuna Import Market
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Tuna industry is developing rapidly in recent years, and it had became a important growth point of the fisheries in China, this paper use the SCP analysis paradigm, emphatically analyzed the market structure of tuna imports market in China and explored the tuna imports market present situation and its causes. The study found that the tuna products in the Chinese tuna import market are very diverse. By giving full play to the advantages of comparative advantage and low labor cost, the emerging tuna fishing countries have formed a fierce competition with the developed countries of traditional tuna industry. But in the high-end import market, the developed countries of traditional tuna industry monopolize the market by taking advantages of their own tuna resources and mature technologies. As for the situation of Chinese tuna circulation, the market information sharing system is not perfect, there is no organized circulation main body, and the industry chain is not complete. Therefore the government should support tuna fishing enterprises to strengthen their own strength, improve the industrial chain, and not only establish the market information sharing and analysis system but also build the standardized retail market.

articleTitle: Proposal for Control Dependency White-Box Test Coverage Metrics for Inheritance
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Several white-box test coverage metrics have been proposed in the literature in the context of object-oriented programs. However, these are not appropriate for the objectoriented feature inheritance. The main reason for this situation is the fact that a class is derived from another class in inheritance. Though there are a large number of well established test coverage metrics have been reported to capture the coverage of objectoriented programs, white-box test coverage metrics to capture the coverage due to inheritance have rarely been reported. In this paper, we propose a set of novel unit test coverage metrics for object-oriented feature inheritance based on execution of control dependences of the JSysDG (Java System Dependency Graph).

Author Keywords: Java System Dependency Graph, object-oriented programs, inheritance, test coverage

articleTitle: A Method of Semantic Redundant Information Filtering for Abstract Meaning Representation Graph
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of semantic redundancy in the existing text summarization, this paper proposes a method of semantic redundant information filtering based on Abstract Meaning Representation Graph. First, it transforms the original text into the corresponding AMR graph, then filters the semantic similar redundant information based on the WordNet semantic dictionary, and then extracts the important parts of AMR graphs to generate a de-redundant summarization. The experimental results show that the semantic redundancy removal method proposed in this paper has significantly improved the ROUGE and Smatch values compared to other word-aligned eliminate redundant methods. The ROUGE-1 increased by 7.2 percentage points and The Smatch increased by 13.2 percentage points. The novelty and readability of the summarization are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Big Data for Modelling Interactive Systems in IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) ideates the flawless interconnection among the things and the webs. It delivers favorable possibilities to build powerful services and applications for the construction of a smart society, smart environment, smart city and more precisely a smart world. It enhances the connectivity to each device, effortless data transfer and provides expected services in time that lead to huge data flow in the system. To monitor, manage, organize and the storage purpose the concept of big data came into act. In the generation of IoT, every work is done automatically without human intervention, machine can sense the requirement with the help of highly active sensors and able to act accordingly, and one can control the things remotely without any due. The overall process generates the continuous generation of data in the system. 3vs i.e. Volume, Variety and Velocity of big data technology has the controlling authority to handle such large dataset. This paper surveys the utilities of big data in the field of various intelligent interactive systems (IISs) which includes real-time systems surveil, data management, optimization and prediction.

articleTitle: Prediction of Dairy Product Quality Risk Based on Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The use of machine learning can study the objective laws of the data to find out the relationship between the data, but also can achieve data classification and prediction. This article is based on national food safety sampling platform for dairy products testing data for the study to predict the risk safety of dairy products. Firstly, the sampling data of dairy products was selected from the database and the data was preprocessed. Then, the characteristic data were selected and classified into these data. Finally, the key food safety risk early-warning model was constructed by using Extreme learning machine (ELM) and the kernel-based extreme learning machine (K-ELM) respectively. Commonly used BP neural network and Support Vector Machines(SVM) network contrast. After ELM and K-ELM again to compare the experimental results. From the experimental results, it can be seen that the neural network algorithm based on kernel extreme learning machine has a high accuracy in food safety prediction and the training time is short. Through the extreme learning machine effective prediction of food safety, to regulate the quality and safety of food, so as to protect the quality of food safety in China.

Author Keywords: Machine learning. Food safety Prediction. Extreme learning machine

articleTitle: Game Analysis on Sales Return Involving B2C E-Commerce Seller, Buyer and Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: B2C E-commerce sellers, buyers and platforms have been concerned about the return problem involved in online shopping. Investigation into sales return through B2C platforms with an aim to figure out the reasons behind it comes to a conclusion that the excludability of benefit of buyer and seller, the influence of Matthew Effect, the information asymmetry between buyer and seller, and the phenomenon of sellers sticking to low-price strategy while the buyers dependent on sales return are four reasons for keeping high return rate. Game analysis on B2C e-commerce platform, seller and buyer shall get underway. First, an income matrix covering the combination of the principle of liability without fault and the doctrine of presumption followed by contracting parties will come into being based on the game analysis is on sellers and buyers to reach the Nash equilibrium under rational state of both parties. Secondly, a conclusion that "the buyer's return action is a rational conduct" will arrive based on the game analysis on sellers and platforms. Lastly, the research finds that the return problem can be alleviated through three stages of strategy, including the rational guidance of customers before consumption, the adjustment of customer expectation in consumption and the promotion of product service after consumption.

articleTitle: A Survey on Malware Detection Approaches Using EULA Analysis with Text Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Malware is a major threat to the computer security. There are so many variants of malware evolving each day which results the loss in economy as well as data and personal information is precious than economy. Malware prevention can be achieved by carefully analyzing the content of the EULA. As EULA analysis deals with analyzing the unstructured text documents, text mining concept plays an important role. This paper analyzes the detection mechanism for malware detection, using text mining over an ample set of existing EULA. The comparison presented in this paper highlights some malware analysis and text mining techniques. Although there are several malware detection systems exist, evolution and revolution is required to fill the gap in malware evolution and detection. In order to achieve the goal or to verify the authenticity of an executable, this paper provides an alternate approach to detect the malware before execution. EULA analysis which acts as gateway can be included in other behavioral or data mining based malware detection system to achieve both external and internal security of the computing system including mobile devices.

Author Keywords: Component, Malware, EULA Analysis, Text Mining, Malware Detection, Survey, Computer Security

articleTitle: Power Quality Analysis in a PV Connected Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper focuses and represents different types of power quality analysis of a grid connected PV system through MATLAB/SIMULINK modelling. There is a brief discussion about voltage swell, voltage sag and transient conditions in a PV connected module. The presented model is used to simulate various power quality disturbances. We can conclude the results from the output waveform and this is helpful for further learning, research and development of power system education.

Author Keywords: PV array, grid, voltage swell, voltage sag

articleTitle: A TVaR-EGARCH-POT Based Market Financing Risk Evaluation of the New OTC (Over the Counter) Market
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the process of Chinese industry conversion and upgrading, technological innovation enterprises play important roles. Technology enterprises could not develop without the support of financial market, and risk involved in their financing processes directly affects investment inclinations of capital market. Through establishing a TVaR-EGARCH-POT model, this investigation measured market financing risk of the new OTC market. This model could effectively indicate the fluctuating aggregation and leverage effect of financial positions. On the other hand, compared with traditional VaR method, TVaR characterizes tail behaviors of capital loss variables more effectively, and in the meanwhile shows higher inclusiveness of occurrence of extreme loss events.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Real and Reactive Power in a Grid Connected Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the advancement of technology, there is a need to connect the world in one link and to provide 24hours access to all facilities. For that it requires the availability of electricity all the time and this paper focus on the various available resources in order to full fill the requirement. We finally end up at the wind power energy by discarding other because of some demerits. The wind power generated is connected to the grid by synchronizing various parameters and its steps to do so has been discussed in this paper. Speaking about the generator, the permanent magnet synchronous generator has been used because of its certain advantage over others. After connecting the model via various converters, the simulation of wind power system and stability analysis was being carried out. The wind flow is being analyzed and its impact on the voltage and reactive and active power is being studied. This paper provides a feasible solution to the wind power modeling and synchronizing of the grid

Author Keywords: Permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG), energy resource available, converter, grid synchronization, wind turbine

articleTitle: The Relationship between the Entrepreneur's Human Capital Property Rights and Corporate Performance in Private Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Using the panel data of 514 listed companies of private enterprises in 2012-2016, the paper studies the influence of the Human Capital Property Right of private entrepreneur on the performance of the company by using the ordinary least square regression model. The Empirical Results show that the Entrepreneur's compensation has a positive effect on the performance of the company. The proportion of entrepreneur's ownership has a positive effect on the performance of the company Entrepreneurial Control has a positive impact on the company's performance. Therefore, based on the study results, the author proposes targeted recommendations for the promotion of the performance of the company from the aspects of increasing the shareholding of the entrepreneur, Raising the salary level of the entrepreneur, determining the appropriate degree of power concentration, strengthening actual ownership of entrepreneurs.

articleTitle: The Discovery of Micro-Blog Users' Interest Groups Based on SSLOK-Means Clustering Focus on Big Data Improved by Calinski-Harabasz
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As a data mining algorithm, the clustering has been widely used in the discovery of micro-blog users' interest groups and provides a new idea to mine users' information for the micro-blog operators. The SSLOK-means algorithm newly proposed can solve the drawback of K-means algorithm when clustering the big data. However, the number of clusters still needs to be set manually in advance, which brings difficulties for using. In this paper, an algorithm of semi supervised labels one scan K-means improved by Calinski-Harabasz function is presented and applied to subdivide users and to discover the interest groups. The micro-blog users' data of Sina have been grabbed to do clustering analysis by the new algorithm. Finally, six different types of interest groups including knowledgeable type, material type, IT type, business type, interconnected type and balanced type have been found. The targeted individual recommendations were given for each type of interest group. The research can provide a support for the optimization of personalized service about micro-blog platform and the earnings promotion of micro-blog marketing, which has important theoretical significance and practical value.

articleTitle: The Impact Factors and Consequences of Members' Participation in SME-Managed Online Brand Community
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Nowadays, the increasing Internet leads to great changes in models and means of branding. By developing online brand communities, some SMEs achieve brand success. Existing studies on online brand community can be categorized into two aspects: studies on the motivation of members participating in online brand communities and studies on the impact of members' participation. However, most of researchers took the communities established and managed by the advocates of strong brands as the study object. Only few of them concern the communities directly managed by the enterprises, especially by SMEs. Without the influence of strong brands, most of the SMEs are faced with the difficulties in recruiting community members and attracting members to participate in community regularly. However, in the real industry, some SMEs have successfully developed powerful online brand community and achieved branding. In this paper, MEIZU official forum is selected as the main study object. Based on literature review and grounded research, a theoretical model has been constructed. Through large-scale survey and data analysis, the hypotheses and relevant conclusions are verified.

articleTitle: Person Re-Identification Based on Attribute Heterogeneity
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In order to improve the recognition accuracy of person re-identification. We proposed a neural network model based on heterogeneity of person attributes. Compared with the existing methods, this model has the following two advantages. First, based on the heterogeneity between attributes. We design the different identification methods to identification different kinds of attributes. Second, aim at the different of loss measurement for the attribute recognition method. We proposed an algorithm consistent with the heterogeneous loss function. The experimental results show that compared with the existing methods, the proposed model is effectively enhance the person recognition rank-1 accuracy. Ours method reached the rank-1 accuracy 88.13% on Market1501, 74.96% on DukeMTMC and 77.64% on PETA dataset.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on Supply Chain Inventory Financing under Demand Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper studies the optimal strategy of inventory financing system under the demand uncertainties. The system is composed of a manufacturer, a retailer and a commercial bank. In order to achieve the optimal order, the capital-constrained retailer has to finance from the bank. The bank is devoted to maximizing its profit by setting a reasonable interest rate. As the core enterprise of the supply chain system, the manufacturer tries to enhance the competitiveness of the supply chain system by setting a reasonable wholesale price and buy-back guarantee mechanism. This mechanism helps share market risks with the retailer and the bank. Bi-Stackelberg game model is used to analyse the optimal strategies of the three players in supply chain system, including the retailer's optimal order, the manufacturer's optimal wholesale price and buy-back subsidy, and the bank's optimal financing interest. We also put forward a term "loss recovery rate", and point out its effects on the optimal decision of the retailer and the bank. Results of theoretical analysis are verified by numerical examples.

Author Keywords: Supply chain financing, Buy back subsidy, Inventory financing, Loss recovery rate, Demand uncertainty

articleTitle: A VM Memory Demand Prediction Algorithm Based on the RBF-Markov
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The utilization of virtual memory is always undefined due to the lasting changes of the service requests and the running programs, so the utilization of the multiple VMs memory particularly complicated. In the existing virtual systems, many resource allocation plans of the VM memory lack an efficient and flexible dynamic adjustment mechanism, which is the main reason of the disharmony state of the virtual system. In the long-term running, the business peaks and valleys of each VM are not synchronous that causes that different machines need different amount of the memory resource. Moreover, with the uncertain external load changing, the service level of VM is also uncertain. So it is an important problem that adjusts the memory dynamically based on the current state. Aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional prediction algorithms, this paper proposes an objectives-oriented algorithm, based on RBF-Markov, to predict the future VMs' memory requirements.

Author Keywords: RBF-Markov, virtual technology, memory optimization, VM
